summary: Frontend-only verification of Phase 9k features on https://treesh-phase5.preview.emergentagent.com/. All major phase-9 feature areas verified working. Previous iteration_17 HIGH regressions are both FIXED: (1) Voice overlay now shrinks to [data-testid=voice-mini-pill] with class 'is-mini' after a voiceApply('change theme to blue') command, and tapping the pill expands back to the orb-wrap. (2) Magic Markup deep selection on Library now opens [data-testid=mkd-panel] when clicking the hero H1 after mkStart(). All other core items pass: search Users tab + empty state + placeholder, Support/Feedback forms with 'not switched on yet' message + mailto to support@treesh.app / feedback@treesh.app and NO network to formsubmit.co, Music Manager link flow (invalid/valid/duplicate messages), Lyric Studio markdown (asterisks replaced with ZWSP/BOM so no visible stars in textarea and preview rail renders clean text), Image Studio free crop (all 8 ratio chips, slider+value, e/se handles, 16:9 click sets ratio≈1.78 and value label '16:9'), Profile hero customize+edit wand icons, badges live inside Stats tab (exactly one [data-testid=profile-badges-section]) with collapsible toggle+peek, Magic Markup on profile (mkd-prof class + panel opens on name tap), /_sbtest.html mock sign-in with a@test.com/secret123 works, hero social buttons appear (friends with badge count 1, find-people, privacy), friends sheet with sxf-accept-dana, privacy sheet with public/private, users search surfacing search-result-user-bella. Preview-tab is correctly absent on desktop width.

ui_bugs.issue: Submitting the Support form without picking a topic (or Feedback form without stars) shows 'Enter your email so we can get back to you.' instead of a topic/stars-specific error. Validation returns the email error first regardless of other missing fields. The valid submit flow still works and shows the correct 'Sending from Treesh isn't switched on yet' + mailto message.

ui_bugs.component: Music Manager cover tabs on queue card
ui_bugs.issue: After adding a valid audio link, the queue card showed 'Added. Give it a title, then save.' but [data-testid^=um-cover-tab-file-] and [data-testid^=um-cover-tab-link-] counts were 0 at that moment. The cover panel may be collapsed by default or require scrolling into the card; full cover-link upload flow not verified end-to-end.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking [data-testid=search-result-user-bella] on /_sbtest.html did not open [data-testid=user-profile] in one run; a direct sxOpenProfile call was not attempted here because the panel navigation was blocked by an already-open profile panel in the second attempt. Could not fully verify uprof-name, uprof-add-friend → uprof-cancel-request, uprof-block/unblock, uprof-private (carlos), uprof-locked-disliked flow. Needs re-test with a fresh page+search sequence.

action_items: LOW: Reorder validation in Support/Feedback submit so missing topic (ts-topic-*) or missing stars shows a topic/stars-specific message before falling back to the email error.

MEDIUM: Verify Music Manager cover panel tabs render on the queue card immediately after a successful link add. Expected selectors: [data-testid=um-cover-tab-file-N], [data-testid=um-cover-tab-link-N] (N = index). If they are collapsed behind an expander, document the trigger; otherwise ensure they render inline on the queue card as the spec says.

MEDIUM: Re-verify the Social user-profile panel click flow. Clicking [data-testid=search-result-user-bella] on /_sbtest.html should open [data-testid=user-profile] with uprof-name/username/zodiac/stats and the uprof-add-friend button that becomes uprof-cancel-request after click; also verify uprof-block/unblock and uprof-private (carlos) + uprof-locked-disliked.
NICE: Add a tiny test hook to deterministically seed window.SONGS on fresh load so Lyric Studio Sync (non-blank) flows can be exercised reliably by automation.
critical_code_review_comments: Support/Feedback (tsSubmit in /app/memory/p9l.js) appears to check email validity before checking topic/stars — move the topic/stars check first and emit targeted error strings so the UI can tell users what is actually missing.

Music Manager (umCovPanel in /app/memory/p9k.js) — ensure the cover tabs are rendered unconditionally in the queue card so [data-testid^=um-cover-tab-] selectors are present as soon as the card appears; today they were absent right after addLink succeeded.

Social (sxRender/sxOpenProfile in /app/memory/p9m.js) — ensure that search-result-user-* elements have a data-act handler that calls sxOpenProfile(id) and that the user-profile panel renders above the search drawer; a click should not require the search to be closed first.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% — all top-level Phase 9 features verified; two previously HIGH regressions FIXED (voice mini-pill, MK Library deep select). Minor validation ordering issue + music-cover tabs visibility + social user-profile click warrant retest.

rca of the issue: Support/Feedback validation: tsSubmit() in /app/memory/p9l.js likely checks the email field (empty or regex-fails) and returns before checking the topic/stars state. Fix: order validations as topic -> message -> email, and set ts-status text accordingly. Music Manager cover tabs: umCovPanel appears to render the cover tabs only after a cover affordance is expanded or after save; the spec expects them inline on each queue card — ensure umRenderQueueCard includes the um-cover-tab-file-N / um-cover-tab-link-N nodes by default. Social search->profile: user card click handler may be opening the profile but under the search overlay z-order; or data-act may be bound to a parent that stops propagation. Delegate the click explicitly to sxOpenProfile and ensure the panel z-index is above the search drawer.
